working: This is a Carnot cycle. Processes 1 and 3 are isothermal, and processes 2 and 4 are adiabatic. Work is taken as done on the gas, w = -∫p dV. For the isothermal steps: w1 = -RT1 ln(V2/V1) = -2T1 ln(V2/V1), and w3 = -2T2 ln(V4/V3). Option (1) is therefore correct. For the adiabatic steps q = 0, so w2 = ΔU2 and w4 = ΔU4 = -ΔU2. That gives w2 + w4 = 0, but ΔU2 - ΔU4 = 2ΔU2 ≠ 0, so (2) fails. Option (3) wrongly omits w2. Option (4) fails because the net work of a cycle equals the enclosed area, which is not zero.
